requirements_summary: Workload: low-latency VS Code inline completions + multiline streaming (editor integration must deliver char-level token stream).
Latency/throughput: target p50 < 80ms for first streamed token; sustain ~2000 concurrent devs in org with graceful degradation.
Cost sensitivity: mid — prefer predictable committed capacity for editing workloads but want optimize suggestions for batching background tasks.
Model preferences: prefer open Llama-family variant tuned for code; need canonical model hash and recommended quantization profile for deterministic outputs.
Routing/fallback: route by policy -> hosted for devs, fallback to dedicated quantized instance under load; optional private for EU customers.
Security: SSO/SAML, seat-based quotas, audit logs retention 13 months, KMS integration for keys, encryption-in-transit + at-rest mandatory.
Integration needs: WebSocket or HTTP/2 streaming endpoints, incremental delta diffs for editor patches, client-side token caching to reduce auth calls.
Evaluation metrics: latency percentiles, token-cost per completion, quality regression measured via test prompt set per release.
POC aims: verify <100ms first token for VS Code local flow, test seat-level throttles, validate model pin/rollback and audit log exports.
